claim_text: High-DOC observations concentrate in weakly monitored areas (low support / high uncertainty)
fail_condition: direction inconsistent in >=3 of 5 target basins, or fewer than 3 adequately sampled ecological strata
non_claim_note: descriptive association only; not a causal account of why gaps exist

claim_text: Ecological blind spots (low support AND high uncertainty AND ecological novelty, or high-DOC risk) form stable ecological and network structure
fail_condition: unstable under bootstrap or alternate masks; strata n < required minimum
non_claim_note: blind-spot definition fixed before results; training-available information only; predictive/descriptive wording

claim_text: H2X lowers MAE by >=10% versus the best no-graph model in at least 2 of E2a/E2b/E3 under one frozen protocol
fail_condition: gate not met on the ST-core cohort with 5 seeds and paired bootstrap intervals
non_claim_note: pilot: mixed-571 multiseed suggests this direction (H2X vs historical RF) but is not same-protocol and not ST-core

claim_text: H2X shows a stable incremental gain over H2E (river + ecology without the encoder) in at least one extrapolation scenario
non_claim_note: without the H2E control the H2X gain cannot be attributed to the encoder; this claim requires that control

claim_text: Transport-gated topology (H2) beats non-graph and directed-only variants outside E1
fail_condition: paired difference approx 0 or direction inconsistent across seeds
non_claim_note: historical evidence shows a stable H2-vs-H1 gain only on E1; treat as open under the frozen protocol

claim_text: H2X does not degrade E1 performance by more than 5% versus the best baseline
non_claim_note: non-inferiority constraint; H2X historically does not improve E1 R2

claim_text: Gain directions are consistent in at least 3 of 5 training seeds and every comparison reports paired differences with cluster-bootstrap intervals
fail_condition: fewer than 3 seeds agree in direction; intervals omitted
non_claim_note: 5 seeds and shared masks do not license significance claims beyond paired counts and intervals

claim_text: Conclusions do not rest on a single HUC2 or a single station type
fail_condition: overall claim reverses or vanishes when one HUC2 is removed
non_claim_note: HUC2=8 ranking reversal is on record for the mixed cohort; ST-only population is the paper scope

claim_text: At equal budget K ecology-aware sampling (uncertainty + ecological representativeness) reduces MAE by >=20% versus random sampling in at least 4 of 5 target basins
fail_condition: gate not met; or any basin worsens >5% while overall success is claimed
non_claim_note: k-shot v2 10% gate is pilot evidence only and is superseded by this 20% gate

claim_text: At equal budget K ecology-aware sampling improves high-DOC (top 5%/10%) recall by >=20% versus random sampling in at least 4 of 5 target basins
fail_condition: recall gain <20% or driven by a single basin
non_claim_note: strategies must never read query ground-truth DOC

claim_text: Ecology-aware sampling needs >=20% fewer samples than random sampling to reach the same error
fail_condition: target error never reached or reduction <20%
non_claim_note: K curve over {0;1;3;5} must be monotone or free of clear anomalies; at least one simple baseline stably beaten

claim_text: 90% prediction intervals are calibrated: overall coverage in 80-95% with no systematic collapse in major ecological strata
fail_condition: coverage outside 80-95%; any major stratum below 70% or above 98%
non_claim_note: intervals must beat uncalibrated seed variance; validation strictly on hidden real observations

claim_text: Uncertainty varies sensibly with network distance, ecological novelty and support count (more distance/novelty or less support -> more uncertainty)
High-DOC tail carries a disproportionate share of error and must be reported separately (tail MAE and tail coverage)
non_claim_note: pilot: mixed-cohort diagnostics show the top 1% of cells carry a median ~74% of squared error

claim_text: Ecological group rankings (landcover / climate / soil / topo ablations) identify which context groups drive predictability
non_claim_note: produced under the env_groups column-selection defect; quarantined; may only be re-claimed from fresh Phase-2 runs after the Phase-1 fix

claim_text: External-basin (or held-out-HUC6) performance degrades by <=25% relative to internal evaluation and stays above at least one simple baseline
fail_condition: degradation >25% or below simple baseline; intervals uncalibrated externally
non_claim_note: on failure the paper scope narrows to within-basin monitoring design; no re-tuning before reporting
